_comment: config.json template for the buyer server (port 8765). Copy to config.json and fill in. NEVER commit config.json — it's in .gitignore.
_password_note: Legacy password login (still works as fallback). Production uses Google OAuth — these are only used if someone hits /api/login directly.
_base_url_note: Used in ECPay ReturnURL / ClientBackURL and OAuth redirect_uri.
_openai_key_note: Used by gen_questions.py and /api/qa/<slug> answer generation.
_openai_proxy_note: Production server in HK is blocked by OpenAI. Tunnel via autossh to probejp.metage.xyz:13367 → forwards to probejp's local 8888 (an HTTP CONNECT proxy). systemd unit: aicdn-tunnel.service
_oauth_note: GCP OAuth credentials. Allowed domain restricts login to @skycloud.com.tw via hd parameter.
_cookie_note: Domain=.aicdn.ai lets www.aicdn.ai and referral.aicdn.ai share session cookie. cookie_root is the suffix for return-URL whitelist (open-redirect protection).
_ecpay_note: Defaults shown are the public ECPay sandbox (anyone can use). Replace with real merchant credentials when going to production. sandbox=false switches to https://payment.ecpay.com.tw.
